title: Great idea... or not? Pros and cons
objective: Discuter des avantages et limites d'une initiative

steps.title: Warm-up: rate the idea
steps.student_instruction: Rate three school initiatives from 1 to 5: a car-free day, no phones at lunch, a school garden. Explain one rating.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Recueillir les notes ; faire émerger advantage / drawback.

steps.title: Listening: Sports centres
steps.student_instruction: Listen to Maya and Bill. Note two advantages and one drawback of each sports centre.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire écouter l'audio British Council (QR code) ; sans réseau, lire le script de secours. Grille avantages / limites pour chaque centre.

steps.title: Language focus: should, could, might
steps.student_instruction: Use should for advice, could for possibilities and might for weaker possibilities.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Modaux + base verbale, sans to ; prononciation sans l. Faire reformuler les idées du warm-up.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet about a car-free day.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : trier avantages et limites ; B : phrases avec modaux ; C : recommandation argumentée.

steps.title: Group discussion
steps.student_instruction: Groups of four: two defend the advantages, two explain the limits, then the group agrees on a recommendation.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Rôles imposés puis consensus ; observer tours de parole, modaux et formules d'accord / désaccord.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write your group's recommendation with should.

sheets.student_content: Sort into advantages or limits of a car-free day: less pollution / difficult for students who live far away / more space to play / buses might be full / people walk more.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Avantages : less pollution, more space to play, people walk more. Limites : difficult for students who live far away, buses might be full.

sheets.student_content: Write six sentences about a car-free day: two with should, two with could, two with might.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : We should organise a bike bus. It could reduce pollution. Some parents might be angry.

sheets.student_content: Write a 120-word recommendation to the head teacher about one initiative: two advantages, two limits, a solution to one limit and a final recommendation.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; critères : équilibre avantages / limites, modaux justes, recommandation claire.

criteria: L'élève formule des avantages et des limites
L'élève utilise should, could, might à bon escient
L'élève participe à la décision commune

common_errors: Liste d'idées sans échange avec le groupe
